description: This file defines the Reward class for handling reward points calculations, confirmation, and unconfirmation within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages reward point application to totals, updates reward data on order confirmation, and removes reward data on order unconfirmation.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Class responsible for managing reward points calculations, confirmation, and removal within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies reward point discounts to the order total, adjusting taxes accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms reward points for an order, updating reward data for the customer.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes reward point data associated with an order upon order cancellation or modification.
